title: GeoLens ArcGIS migration plan v2
description: Editable plan written by `geolens arcgis plan` from an inventory. The operator edits it; the migration reads it. Running `plan` again merges a newer inventory into it, keeping the edits.

path.description: The inventory the plan was built from, relative to the plan file.

started_at.description: When the inventory the plan was last built or merged from started reading the portal, by the portal's clock; cutover asks the portal for items changed since.

complete.description: False when the inventory was partial or truncated, so the plan may miss items.

scope.description: The scope of the inventory the plan was last built or merged from. Only a complete org-scope inventory read signed in marks items removed.

auth.description: How the inventory signed in, and as whom.

visibility.description: Used for an item whose ArcGIS sharing level has no GeoLens equivalent.

owner_map.description: ArcGIS username to the GeoLens username or email that will own the item. Empty until filled in; the migration refuses an owner left empty.

group_map.description: ArcGIS group id to the GeoLens group that items shared only with groups are shared with (geolens_group). The migration names the GeoLens group it creates after the inventory's group title; collection names it only when the inventory has none.

geolens_group.description: null or absent: the migration creates a GeoLens group named after the ArcGIS group and adds its members. A name: the existing GeoLens group to share with instead, whose members are left as they are. Empty: the group maps to no GeoLens group.

basemap_map.description: Basemap layer URL used by a web map to the GeoLens basemap id that replaces it. Empty means no replacement chosen.

owner.description: The ArcGIS username that owns the item.
GeoLens username or email that overrides owner_map for this item; null uses owner_map.

visibility.description: restricted: shared with the GeoLens groups the item's ArcGIS groups map to, or private when none maps.

collections.description: Collections the item joins: its folder, plus any added by hand. ArcGIS groups become GeoLens groups and visibility, not collections.

groups.description: ArcGIS group ids the item is shared with; the executor shares a restricted item with each group's GeoLens group (group_map). null means group sharing was not read, so the groups the item is shared with are unknown.

depends_on.description: Items to migrate first. An id missing from this plan's items is not in the inventory.

alias_of.description: Set by hand on an unfiltered hosted view with action skip: web maps that use it point at this parent item's dataset.

superseded_by.description: The hosted layer item this source file was published into, so the file's rows are not imported twice.

removed.description: True when the item was gone from the portal at the last merge. It is not run again, and what it already migrated stays in GeoLens.

unlisted.description: True when the inventory of the last merge didn't list the item but couldn't show it was gone (partial, user scope or anonymous). The migration leaves it pending until a merge lists it again.

defaults.description: The values `plan` gave this item. A merge replaces a value that still equals its default and keeps one that differs; an edited value's default doesn't move, so the edit stays until it is set back. Without it every value counts as edited.
